subject.title: fix(browser): bring tab to foreground before screenshot capture

question: May direct-CDP screenshot capture leave the target tab foregrounded as the compatibility cost for avoiding background-tab screenshot hangs?
rationale: The code path and CDP contract support the fix, but deciding whether screenshot is allowed to mutate foreground tab state is a product compatibility choice.

options.title: Accept Screenshot Foregrounding
options.body: Land this PR with the documented side effect because it is the narrow CDP-level fix for backgrounded-tab screenshot hangs.

options.title: Require Prior-Tab Restore
options.body: Ask for a focused follow-up that records and restores the previously active tab around capture when that state is reliable.

options.title: Keep Screenshots Non-Mutating
options.body: Pause or close this PR if browser inspection commands must never change the foreground tab.

recommendation.title: Accept Screenshot Foregrounding
recommendation.body: Land this PR with the documented side effect because it is the narrow CDP-level fix for backgrounded-tab screenshot hangs.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent browser CDP ownership history and merged the current main rewrite touching this surface.
